# requires host

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:requiresHost`](gmeow-requiresHost.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/requiresHost>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Asserts whether a reference frame requires a hosting entity to exist.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md) -> [`xsd:boolean`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#boolean); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:requiresHost`](gmeow-requiresHost.md) from [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](../classes/gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md) to [`xsd:boolean`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#boolean) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to assert whether a reference frame needs a hosting entity to exist; functional boolean.

### Avoid when

- Avoid naming the host here (use [`gmeow:isHostedBy`](gmeow-isHostedBy.md)) — this flag only states whether a host is required.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:requiresHost`](gmeow-requiresHost.md) true for frames bound to a host (a robot base, a building grid) and pair with [`gmeow:isHostedBy`](gmeow-isHostedBy.md) on instances.

### Examples

- [`gmeow:referenceFrameRobotArm6DOF`](../individuals/gmeow-referenceFrameRobotArm6DOF.md) [`gmeow:requiresHost`](gmeow-requiresHost.md) true.
